common_support: Age-by-cohort cells observed in all three partitions
reference: Pooled person-wave distribution of common-support cells, held fixed during bootstrap
decomposition: Symmetric Kitagawa decomposition within common support, plus exact full-minus-common residual; no historical 2018-cohort rate imputed
resampling: 500 paired person-cluster draws spanning all partitions
interpretation: Descriptive decomposition; neither causal effects nor a correction of follow-up selection
